# Bloxioe's Blog

> A personal blog by Bloxioe about technology, software development, open source, and current developments. Posts are written and curated by the author; they may include news commentary, tutorials, project notes, and opinion. RSS and this index are generated from the site's published content at build time.

{% endunless %}
{% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}

## Published blog posts

{% assign posts = site.news | where_exp: "post", "post.draft != true" | sort: "date" | reverse %}
{% for post in posts %}
- [{{ post.title }}]({{ site.url }}{{ post.url }}) ({{ post.date | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}){% if post.description %}: {{ post.description | strip_html | normalize_whitespace }}{% endif %}
{% endfor %}

## Feeds and full text

- [Blog RSS feed]({{ site.url }}/blog/feed.xml): Full content of every published blog post; refreshed whenever the site is built.
- [Full site text]({{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt): Text versions of public pages and published blog posts, generated from the current site content.
- [XML sitemap]({{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml): Public site URLs.
- [Contact]({{ site.url }}/contact/): Send feedback, corrections, or a topic suggestion.
